content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for HLL Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment process is being conducted by HLL Lifecare (HLL), a premier public sector undertaking offering temporary apprentice opportunities in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available under HLL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The positions available include Trade Apprentice, Technician Apprentice, and Vocational Apprentice across various disciplines under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for HLL recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is completely through a walk-in interview process. Candidates must report directly to the designated venue with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the walk-in date for the HLL apprentice posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in selection tests are scheduled to be conducted on 05 October 2026 and 06 October 2026. Candidates must verify their specific schedule and reporting times beforehand.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum qualification required for Trade Apprentice?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Trade Apprentice position must have successfully completed an ITI Pass from a recognized institution or board.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are needed for Technician Apprentice posts?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Technician Apprentice (Diploma) post need a 3 year Diploma course, while Vocational Apprentice applicants require a Vocational Pass qualification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary or stipend offered for these apprentice roles?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly stipend ranging from Rs. 9,600/- to Rs. 11,040/- depending on the specific post and qualification level.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to attend the walk-in?
faq.answer: No application fee is required to participate in the walk-in interview process as per the official notification details provided.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry to the walk-in venue?
faq.answer: Candidates must report before 11 am with attested photocopies of educational certificates, passport-size photographs, and original along with copies of their Aadhaar card.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in location for HLL Lifecare recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview takes place in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala (Pincode: 695017). Candidates should check the detailed notification for the exact building and room address.
